title: Hugging Face releases OlmoEarth v1.3 satellite embedding model
excerpt: The new model provides 128-dimensional vectors for satellite imagery to assist in environmental monitoring and land-cover analysis.
bodyHtml:
Hugging Face released OlmoEarth v1.3 on October 22, 2026, a satellite embedding model designed to compress satellite data into features for various tasks. The model uses a vision transformer to process radar and multispectral satellite time series, producing a 128-dimensional vector for every 10-meter pixel on Earth.

The release includes precomputed annual embeddings for the entire planet and a browser-based tool called the OlmoEarth Embeddings Explorer. This tool allows users to explore and customize maps based on the embeddings without requiring sign-in or advanced technical knowledge.

According to Hugging Face, the 128-dimensional embeddings outperformed AlphaEarth Foundations and Tessera v2 in 20 of 27 evaluations. The model weights, pretraining data, and pretraining code are available under the open OlmoEarth Artifact License. Pre-training the base model cost roughly $2,720 of rented H100 time for the final run.
